Party

Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subhash Chand
------
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Ranjit Kumar Tiwari, Advocate
For the State : Mr. Jitendra Pandey, A.P.P.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed applicant with prayer to
release on bail in connection with Pocso Case No.103 of 2021 registered under Sections 366-A, 376
of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Pocso Act pending in the court of learned Special
Judge, Pocso Act, Garhwa.
3.  Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that earlier the prayer for bail of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 9th June, 2022 passed in B.A. No.4147 of 2022.

By way of present bail application, the applicant has renewed his prayer for bail, primarily for the reasons that after rejection of the first bail application, P.W.-1 Dr. Maheru Yamni, P.W.-2 Magni Devi,
P.W.-3 Nepal Ram, P.W.-4 Runika Kumari @ Runi Kumari, P.W.-5 Rajni Devi, P.W.-6 Lal Mohan Korwa and P.W.-7 Puja Kumari @ Ritika Kumari have been examined before the trial court and they have not supported the prosecution case.
4. Learned A.P.P. appearing on behalf of the State vehemently opposed the contentions made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

5. The first bail application of the applicant was rejected on merit and thereafter if the witnesses who were examined before the trial court have not supported the prosecution case, their testimony Manoj Korwa vs The State Of Jharkhand .... ....
